Our Services

Medical transport for every situation

From life-threatening emergencies to planned transfers, one call connects you to the right vehicle and crew.

01

Emergency Transport

Rapid movement of patients in urgent need to the right hospital, day or night.

02

Critical / ICU Ambulance

Equipped for serious conditions with ventilator, monitors and medication, and staffed by trained medical professionals.

03

Air Medical Transport

Helicopter or fixed-wing transfer for critical patients who need rapid access to specialised care.

04

Interfacility Transfer

Hospital-to-hospital transfers with continuity of care, from Noida and Delhi NCR to anywhere in India and Nepal.

05

Private & Non-Emergency

Comfortable, private patient transport with stretcher and wheelchair support.

06

Event Medical Standby

On-site ambulance and paramedic cover for concerts, sports, festivals and large gatherings.

07

Transplant Services

Timely, coordinated transport of organs, tissues and patients needing urgent transplants.

08

Freezer & Hearse Van

Respectful transport of the departed, with freezer and hearse vans available round the clock.

About Us

Care you can count on

Tanu Ambulance Services serves Noida and all of Delhi NCR from Main Road, Shaheed Arjun Sardana Marg, near Kailash Hospital in Sector 19. Our team is on call day and night to move patients quickly, safely and with compassion.

  • Emergency and non-emergency medical transport
  • Ambulances with life-support equipment and trained paramedics
  • Freezer and hearse vans for dignified last journeys
  • One number to call, 24 hours a day
